title.narrative: Global Health Supply Chain - Procurement and Supply Management (GSHC-PSM) IDIQ - HIV/AIDS Task Order

description.narrative: The purpose of the Global Health Supply Chain - Procurement and Supply Management single award IDIQ contract is to ensure uninterrupted supplies of health commodities to prevent suffering, save lives, and strengthen supply chain systems in low and middle- income countries. The IDIQ has three task orders, one of which directly support the Presidents Emergency Plan for AIDS Relief (PEPFAR)..
